notes: Uses actual fully serialized stable-profile payload sizes and high-rate timings, including both whole and chunk containers.
All 15 formal TTFT contexts are identical to readiness. Twelve executions per condition account for ten formal and two warmups.
Quality matrix is ten times readiness; adaptive formal plus warmup executions are fifty times readiness executions.
Adaptive estimate extrapolates one fact/trace to five facts/five traces; decisions, trace values, generation length, pacing and load can change runtime.
Pipeline overlap varies with bandwidth; low-rate socket overhead is not perfectly additive. Reserve further time.
